name: Krat Adventure Wilderness
description: A cinematic wilderness landing page inspired by premium outdoor editorial campaigns, combining oversized typography, saturated photography, asymmetrical adventure cards, field-note details, and a deep navy palette.
features: cinematic full-screen hero with oversized editorial typography
featured expedition image with route statistics
scroll progress indicator and subtle hover motion
semantic HTML, keyboard focus states, skip link, alt text, and reduced-motion support
no build step required; Tailwind CSS CDN
